description: Legacy app config surfaces the compat mapper (core/src/app/config/legacy.ts) still accepts (KRN-11a). Each entry is one surface of LEGACY_CONFIG_SURFACES; the package named by fixedBy removes the surface and its entry together.

entries.reason: The legacy config root; the starters and the docs site move to jsails.config.ts with defineApp, and the default config path flips with them.
The pages directory; routes come from the AppManifest instead.
The API directory; routes come from the AppManifest instead.
The static-assets directory; the build pipeline owns its asset directory.
The export directory; the build pipeline owns its output directory.
The deployment shape; a process states the roles it runs (web, worker, export).
The session resolver; an authenticator plugin provides the actor.
The identity source; an authenticator plugin provides the actor.
The app setup hook; a definePlugin instance in plugins.use does the same with declared services. Its provider exists; removal moves the starters.
Legacy extension objects; definePlugin instances in plugins.use replace them. Their provider exists; removal moves the starters after KRN-10b converts the remaining plugins.

The page renderer override. REQ-08 typed its contract (a renderer answers with a PageOutcome); removing the key moves the implicit pages plugin the kernel installs onto plugins.use, which is KRN-11b's.
The runtime introspection endpoint; the introspection plugin replaces it.
Site-wide SEO defaults; the seo plugin replaces them.
The i18n block the kernel turns into the i18n plugin; the app lists the i18n plugin instance in plugins.use instead.
The request-error hook; the app/error hook module replaces it.
The error-page renderer; the pages/_error hook module replaces it.
Readiness options; plugins contribute readiness checks.
The system-check registry; plugins contribute readiness checks.
String and [specifier, options] entries in plugins.use; the app imports the plugin's definePlugin factory and lists its instance.
